-- What a client importing `Proof.go_etcd_io.raft.v3.InvStorage` sees of it (generated by etc/gen-interface.py; do not edit).
-- Every declaration also takes the ambient section variables (left out below): the Go semantics
-- (`ext`, `ffi`, `go_gctx`, `sem`, the package's `Assumptions`), `GF`, `hG`, `StorageModel GF`, `AllG GF`.

theorem ksnCert_pers (sn : StorNames) (k : SnapTrip) : Persistent (ksnCert sn k)

theorem storApp_pend (σ : StorState) (q pend : List EntryM) : storApp { prev := σ.prev, ents :=
    σ.ents, pend := q, fl := σ.fl, fr := σ.fr, sg := σ.sg, dt := σ.dt } pend = storApp σ pend

structure StorageModel.{u_1} (GF : BundledGFunctors) : Type u_1 where
  storLog : IProp GF
  storEnd : IProp GF
  storCompacted : IProp GF
  storLog_app : storLog st k dq (a ++ b) ⊣⊢ storLog st k dq a ∗ storLog st (k + a.length) dq b
  storLog_frac : storLog st k (dq1 • dq2) es ⊣⊢ storLog st k dq1 es ∗ storLog st k dq2 es
  storLog_valid : storLog st k dq es ⊢ ⌜✓ dq⌝
  storLog_agree : storLog st k1 dq1 es1 ∗ storLog st k2 dq2 es2 ⊢ ⌜LogAgree k1 es1 k2 es2⌝
  storLog_persist : storLog st k dq es ⊢ |==> storLog st k DFrac.discard es
  storLog_persistent : Persistent (storLog st k DFrac.discard es)
  storLog_nil : ⊢ storLog st k dq []
  storEnd_excl : storEnd st e ∗ storEnd st e' ⊢ False
  storCompacted_persistent : Persistent (storCompacted st c)
  storCompacted_zero : ⊢ storCompacted st 0
  storCompacted_mono : storCompacted st c ⊢ storCompacted st c'

def storApp (σ : StorState) (pend : List EntryM) : List EntryM :=
  match pend with
  | [] => σ.ents
  | e0 :: tail => List.take (uint.Z e0.Index' - uint.Z σ.prev.index' - 1).toNat σ.ents ++ pend

def PendAbove (σ : StorState) (p : List EntryM) : Prop :=
  ∀ (e0 : EntryM), p.head? = some e0 → uint.Z σ.fl < uint.Z e0.Index'

def ksnCerts (sn : StorNames) (K : List SnapTrip) : IProp GF :=
  [∗list] k ∈ K, ksnCert sn k

def appendRight (st : Storage) (p : List EntryM) : IProp GF :=
  iprop(⌜p = []⌝ ∨
      ∃ e0 old,
        ⌜p.head? = some e0⌝ ∗
          storLog st (uint.nat e0.Index') (DFrac.own 1) old ∗ storEnd st (uint.nat e0.Index' + old.length))

theorem storGiven_pers (sn : StorNames) (k : Nat) : Persistent (storGiven sn k)

theorem ksnCerts_pers (sn : StorNames) (K : List SnapTrip) : Persistent (ksnCerts sn K)

def appendReceipt (st : Storage) (p a : List EntryM) : IProp GF :=
  iprop(⌜p = []⌝ ∨
      ∃ e0 b,
        ⌜p.head? = some e0 ∧ p = a ++ b⌝ ∗
          storLog st (uint.nat e0.Index') DFrac.discard a ∗
            storLog st (uint.nat e0.Index' + a.length) (DFrac.own 1) b ∗ storEnd st (uint.nat e0.Index' + p.length))

structure StorState : Type where
  prev : entryID
  ents : List EntryM
  pend : List EntryM
  fl : w64
  fr : Nat
  sg : Nat
  dt : GMap Nat w64

def raftBnd (sn : StorNames) (c : Nat) : IProp GF :=
  iprop(∃ k, ⌜c ≤ k⌝ ∗ (monoNatLbOwn sn.ga k ∨ monoNatLbOwn sn.gg k))

theorem ksnCerts_nil (sn : StorNames) : ⊢ ksnCerts sn []

def PendOk (σ : StorState) (p : List EntryM) : Prop :=
  p ≠ [] ∧
    ∀ (e0 : EntryM),
      p.head? = some e0 →
        uint.Z σ.prev.index' < uint.Z e0.Index' ∧
          uint.Z e0.Index' ≤ uint.Z σ.prev.index' + ↑σ.ents.length + 1 ∧
            ∀ (k : Nat) (e : EntryM), p[k]? = some e → uint.Z e.Index' = uint.Z e0.Index' + ↑k

theorem raftBnd_pers (sn : StorNames) (c : Nat) : Persistent (raftBnd sn c)

theorem storFloor_pers (sn : StorNames) (x : w64) : Persistent (storFloor sn x)

def svCert (sn : StorNames) (sv : SnapshotM) : IProp GF :=
  iprop(∃ SV, savedPredOwn sn.gsv DFrac.discard SV ∗ □ SV sv)

def storCut (st : Storage) (n : Int) : IProp GF :=
  storCompacted st n.toNat

def ownStorage (sn : StorNames) (st : Storage) (σ : StorState) : IProp GF :=
  iprop(∃ e0,
      storCompacted st (uint.nat σ.prev.index') ∗
        storLog st (uint.nat σ.prev.index') DFrac.discard (e0 :: List.take (σ.fr - uint.nat σ.prev.index') σ.ents) ∗
          storLog st (σ.fr + 1) (DFrac.own 1)
              (List.drop (σ.fr - uint.nat σ.prev.index') (List.take (σ.kOut - uint.nat σ.prev.index' - 1) σ.ents)) ∗
            (⌜σ.pend ≠ []⌝ ∨ storEnd st (uint.nat σ.prev.index' + 1 + σ.ents.length)) ∗
              storAuths sn σ ∗
                ⌜e0.Term' = σ.prev.term' ∧
                    uint.nat σ.prev.index' ≤ σ.fr ∧
                      σ.fr + 1 ≤ σ.kOut ∧
                        σ.kOut ≤ uint.nat σ.prev.index' + 1 + σ.ents.length ∧ σ.sg ≤ uint.nat σ.prev.index'⌝)

theorem storPast_pers (st : Storage) (m : Int) : Persistent (storPast st m)

theorem storPast_of_cut (st : Storage) (n : Int) : storCut st n ⊢ storPast st n

def isStorageD (sn : StorNames) (st : Storage) : IProp GF :=
  isStorageWith (ownStorage sn st) (storCut st) (svCert sn) st

theorem storCut_pers (st : Storage) (n : Int) : Persistent (storCut st n)

def snapshotM_countable : Pos.Countable SnapshotM :=
  countableOfLeftInverse
    (fun s =>
      (s.Data', s.Metadata'.ConfState'.Voters', s.Metadata'.ConfState'.Learners', s.Metadata'.ConfState'.VotersOutgoing',
        s.Metadata'.ConfState'.LearnersNext', s.Metadata'.ConfState'.AutoLeave', s.Metadata'.Index', s.Metadata'.Term'))
    (fun p =>
      { Data' := p.fst,
        Metadata' :=
          {
            ConfState' :=
              { Voters' := p.snd.fst, Learners' := p.snd.snd.fst, VotersOutgoing' := p.snd.snd.snd.fst,
                LearnersNext' := p.snd.snd.snd.snd.fst, AutoLeave' := p.snd.snd.snd.snd.snd.fst },
            Index' := p.snd.snd.snd.snd.snd.snd.fst, Term' := p.snd.snd.snd.snd.snd.snd.snd } })
    snapshotM_countable._proof_1

def isStorageV (sn : StorNames) (st : Storage) : IProp GF :=
  iprop(∃ SV Bnd DL,
      isStorageP SV Bnd DL st ∗
        savedPredOwn sn.gsv DFrac.discard SV ∗
          (□ ∀ sv, SV sv -∗ □ SV sv) ∗
            (□ ∀ c, Bnd c -∗ raftBnd sn c) ∗
              □
                ∀ sv,
                  SV sv -∗
                    DL (uint.nat sv.Metadata'.Index') ={⊤}=∗ raftDL sn (uint.nat sv.Metadata'.Index') sv.Metadata'.Term')

def storAbsorb (σ : StorState) : StorState :=
  { prev := σ.prev, ents := storApp σ σ.pend, pend := [], fl := σ.fl, fr := σ.fr, sg := σ.sg, dt := σ.dt }

theorem storLog_discard_pers.{u_1} (st : Storage) (k : Nat) (es : List EntryM) : Persistent (storLog
    st k DFrac.discard es)

def storFloor (sn : StorNames) (x : w64) : IProp GF :=
  monoNatLbOwn sn.ga (uint.nat x)

def termAt (prev : entryID) (ents : List EntryM) (i : w64) : Option w64 :=
  if uint.Z i = uint.Z prev.index' then some prev.term'
  else (fun e => e.Term') <$> ents[(uint.Z i - uint.Z prev.index' - 1).toNat]?

theorem svCert_pers (sn : StorNames) (sv : SnapshotM) : Persistent (svCert sn sv)

theorem ksnCerts_snoc (sn : StorNames) (K : List SnapTrip) (k : SnapTrip) : ⊢ ksnCerts sn K -∗
    ksnCert sn k -∗ ksnCerts sn (K ++ [k])

def raftDL (sn : StorNames) (i : Nat) (t : w64) : IProp GF :=
  iprop(i ↪[sn.gd]□ t ∨ ∃ k, ⌜i < k⌝ ∗ monoNatLbOwn sn.gg k)

def storAuths (sn : StorNames) (σ : StorState) : IProp GF :=
  iprop(monoNatAuthOwn sn.ga 1 (uint.nat σ.fl) ∗ monoNatAuthOwn sn.gg 1 σ.sg ∗ ghostMapAuth sn.gd 1 σ.dt)

def isStorageWith (P : StorState → IProp GF) (CT : Int → IProp GF) (SC : SnapshotM → IProp GF) (st :
    Storage) : IProp GF :=
  iprop(∃ i,
      "%Hstok" ∷ ⌜st = GoInterface.ok i⌝ ∗
        ("#HLastIndex" ∷
            ∀ σ,
              □
                ∀ Φ,
                  P σ ∗ ⌜σ.pend = []⌝ -∗
                    (▷
                        ∀ li,
                          ⌜uint.Z li = uint.Z σ.prev.index' + ↑σ.ents.length⌝ ∗ P σ -∗
                            Φ (intoVal li, intoVal GoInterface.nil)) -∗
                      WP
                        ((intoVal (methods i.ty go!"LastIndex" i.v))
                          (intoVal ()))
                        {{ Φ }}) ∗
          ("#HFirstIndex" ∷
              ∀ σ,
                □
                  ∀ Φ,
                    P σ -∗
                      (▷
                          ∀ fi,
                            ⌜uint.Z σ.prev.index' + 1 ≤ uint.Z fi ∧
                                    uint.Z fi ≤ max (uint.Z σ.prev.index') (uint.Z σ.fl) + 1⌝ ∗
                                (⌜uint.Z fi = uint.Z σ.prev.index' + 1⌝ ∨ CT (uint.Z fi - 1)) ∗ P σ -∗
                              Φ (intoVal fi, intoVal GoInterface.nil)) -∗
                        WP
                          ((intoVal
                              (methods i.ty go!"FirstIndex" i.v))
                            (intoVal ()))
                          {{ Φ }}) ∗
            ("#HTerm" ∷
                ∀ σ i0 ec,
                  □
                    ∀ Φ,
                      P σ ∗
                          ⌜uint.Z σ.prev.index' ≤ uint.Z i0 ∧ uint.Z i0 ≤ uint.Z σ.prev.index' + ↑σ.ents.length⌝ ∗
                            ⌜PendFrom σ (uint.Z i0 + 1)⌝ ∗ typedPointsto (globalAddr ErrCompacted) ec DFrac.discard -∗
                        (▷
                            ∀ t err,
                              (⌜err = GoInterface.nil ∧ termAt σ.prev σ.ents i0 = some t⌝ ∨
                                    ⌜err = ec ∧ uint.Z i0 < uint.Z σ.fl⌝ ∗ CT (uint.Z i0 + 1)) ∗
                                  P σ -∗
                                Φ (intoVal t, intoVal err)) -∗
                          WP ((intoVal (methods i.ty go!"Term" i.v)) (intoVal i0)) {{ Φ }}) ∗
              ("#HEntries" ∷
                  ∀ σ lo hi maxSize ec,
                    □
                      ∀ Φ,
                        P σ ∗
                            ⌜uint.Z σ.prev.index' + 1 ≤ uint.Z lo ∧
                                  uint.Z lo < uint.Z hi ∧ uint.Z hi ≤ uint.Z σ.prev.index' + ↑σ.ents.length + 1⌝ ∗
                              ⌜PendFrom σ (uint.Z hi)⌝ ∗ typedPointsto (globalAddr ErrCompacted) ec DFrac.discard -∗
                          (▷
                              ∀ s es err,
                                ⌜err = ec ∧ uint.Z lo ≤ uint.Z σ.fl⌝ ∗ CT (uint.Z lo) ∗ P σ ∨
                                    ⌜err = GoInterface.nil⌝ ∗
                                      entsRO s es ∗
                                        ⌜es ≠ [] ∧
                                              ↑es.length ≤ uint.Z hi - uint.Z lo ∧
                                                (∀ (e : EntryM),
                                                    e ∈ es →
                                                      e ∈ List.take (uint.Z hi - uint.Z σ.prev.index' - 1).toNat σ.ents) ∧
                                                  s.cap = s.len ∧
                                                    es <+:
                                                      List.drop (uint.Z lo - uint.Z σ.prev.index' - 1).toNat
                                                        (List.take (uint.Z hi - uint.Z σ.prev.index' - 1).toNat σ.ents)⌝ ∗
                                          P σ -∗
                                  Φ (intoVal s, intoVal err)) -∗
                            WP
                              ((((intoVal (methods i.ty go!"Entries" i.v))
                                    (intoVal lo))
                                  (intoVal hi))
                                (intoVal maxSize))
                              {{ Φ }}) ∗
                ("#Hbounded" ∷
                    □
                      ∀ σ,
                        P σ -∗
                          ⌜(σ.pend = [] → uint.Z σ.prev.index' + ↑σ.ents.length < 2 ^ 61) ∧
                                ∀ (e0 : EntryM), σ.pend.head? = some e0 → uint.Z e0.Index' ≤ 2 ^ 61⌝ ∗
                            P σ) ∗
                  "#HSnapshot" ∷
                    ∀ σ esu n,
                      □
                        ∀ Φ,
                          P σ ∗
                              typedPointsto (globalAddr ErrSnapshotTemporarilyUnavailable) esu DFrac.discard ∗
                                (⌜n ≤ 0⌝ ∨ CT n) -∗
                            (▷
                                ∀ snap err,
                                  P σ ∗
                                      (⌜err = esu⌝ ∨
                                        ⌜err = GoInterface.nil⌝ ∗
                                          ∃ sv,
                                            ownSnapM snap (DFrac.own 1) sv ∗
                                              ⌜(σ.prev.index' ≠ W64 0 ∨ 1 ≤ n → sv.Metadata'.Index' ≠ W64 0) ∧
                                                    uint.Z σ.prev.index' ≤ uint.Z sv.Metadata'.Index' ∧
                                                      n ≤ uint.Z sv.Metadata'.Index'⌝ ∗
                                                (⌜sv.Metadata'.Index' = W64 0⌝ ∨
                                                  SC sv ∗
                                                    ⌜σ.dt !! uint.nat sv.Metadata'.Index' = some sv.Metadata'.Term'⌝)) -∗
                                    Φ (intoVal snap, intoVal err)) -∗
                              WP
                                ((intoVal (methods i.ty go!"Snapshot" i.v))
                                  (intoVal ()))
                                {{ Φ }})

def storGiven (sn : StorNames) (k : Nat) : IProp GF :=
  monoNatLbOwn sn.gg k

theorem storPast_one (st : Storage) (x : w64) : storPast st (uint.Z x + 1) ⊢ storPast st 1

def PendFrom (σ : StorState) (n : Int) : Prop :=
  ∀ (e0 : EntryM), σ.pend.head? = some e0 → n ≤ uint.Z e0.Index'

def LogAgree (k1 : Nat) (es1 : List EntryM) (k2 : Nat) (es2 : List EntryM) : Prop :=
  ∀ (i : Nat) (e1 e2 : EntryM), k1 ≤ i → k2 ≤ i → es1[i - k1]? = some e1 → es2[i - k2]? = some e2 → e1 = e2

def isStorageP (SV : SnapshotM → IProp GF) (Bnd DL : Nat → IProp GF) (st : Storage) : IProp GF :=
  iprop(∃ i,
      "%Hstok" ∷ ⌜st = GoInterface.ok i⌝ ∗
        ("#HLastIndex" ∷
            ∀ e,
              □
                ∀ Φ,
                  storEnd st e -∗
                    (▷ ∀ li, storEnd st e ∗ ⌜uint.nat li + 1 = e⌝ -∗ Φ (intoVal li, intoVal GoInterface.nil)) -∗
                      WP
                        ((intoVal (methods i.ty go!"LastIndex" i.v))
                          (intoVal ()))
                        {{ Φ }}) ∗
          ("#HTerm" ∷
              ∀ k dq es i0 ec,
                □
                  ∀ Φ,
                    storLog st k dq es ∗
                        ⌜k ≤ uint.nat i0 ∧ uint.nat i0 < k + es.length⌝ ∗
                          typedPointsto (globalAddr ErrCompacted) ec DFrac.discard -∗
                      (▷
                          ∀ t err,
                            storLog st k dq es ∗
                                (⌜err = GoInterface.nil ∧ (fun e => e.Term') <$> es[uint.nat i0 - k]? = some t⌝ ∨
                                  ⌜err = ec⌝ ∗ storCompacted st (uint.nat i0 + 1)) -∗
                              Φ (intoVal t, intoVal err)) -∗
                        WP ((intoVal (methods i.ty go!"Term" i.v)) (intoVal i0)) {{ Φ }}) ∗
            ("#HEntries" ∷
                ∀ k dq1 dq2 a b lo hi maxSize ec,
                  □
                    ∀ Φ,
                      storLog st k dq1 a ∗
                          storLog st (k + a.length) dq2 b ∗
                            ⌜k ≤ uint.nat lo ∧ uint.nat lo < uint.nat hi ∧ uint.nat hi ≤ k + a.length + b.length⌝ ∗
                              typedPointsto (globalAddr ErrCompacted) ec DFrac.discard -∗
                        (▷
                            ∀ s es err,
                              storLog st k dq1 a ∗
                                  storLog st (k + a.length) dq2 b ∗
                                    (⌜err = ec⌝ ∗ storCompacted st (uint.nat lo) ∨
                                      ⌜err = GoInterface.nil⌝ ∗
                                        entsRO s es ∗
                                          ⌜es ≠ [] ∧
                                              s.cap = s.len ∧
                                                es <+:
                                                  List.take (uint.nat hi - uint.nat lo)
                                                    (List.drop (uint.nat lo - k) (a ++ b))⌝) -∗
                                Φ (intoVal s, intoVal err)) -∗
                          WP
                            ((((intoVal (methods i.ty go!"Entries" i.v)) (intoVal lo))
                                (intoVal hi))
                              (intoVal maxSize))
                            {{ Φ }}) ∗
              ("#HFirstIndex" ∷
                  ∀ c,
                    □
                      ∀ Φ,
                        storCompacted st c -∗
                          (▷
                              ∀ fi,
                                ⌜c + 1 ≤ uint.nat fi⌝ ∗ storCompacted st (uint.nat fi - 1) -∗
                                  Φ (intoVal fi, intoVal GoInterface.nil)) -∗
                            WP
                              ((intoVal
                                  (methods i.ty go!"FirstIndex" i.v))
                                (intoVal ()))
                              {{ Φ }}) ∗
                ("#HSnapshot" ∷
                    ∀ c esu,
                      □
                        ∀ Φ,
                          storCompacted st c ∗
                              typedPointsto (globalAddr ErrSnapshotTemporarilyUnavailable) esu DFrac.discard -∗
                            (▷
                                ∀ snap err,
                                  (⌜err = esu⌝ ∨
                                      ⌜err = GoInterface.nil⌝ ∗
                                        ∃ sv,
                                          ownSnapM snap (DFrac.own 1) sv ∗
                                            ⌜c ≤ uint.nat sv.Metadata'.Index'⌝ ∗
                                              (⌜sv.Metadata'.Index' = W64 0⌝ ∨
                                                SV sv ∗ DL (uint.nat sv.Metadata'.Index'))) -∗
                                    Φ (intoVal snap, intoVal err)) -∗
                              WP
                                ((intoVal (methods i.ty go!"Snapshot" i.v))
                                  (intoVal ()))
                                {{ Φ }}) ∗
                  ("#Hbound" ∷ □ ∀ c, storCompacted st c ={⊤}=∗ Bnd c) ∗
                    "#Hlen" ∷ □ ∀ k dq es, storLog st k dq es -∗ ⌜es = [] ∨ k + es.length ≤ 2 ^ 61⌝ ∗ storLog st k dq es)

theorem isStorage_pers (sn : StorNames) (st : Storage) : Persistent (isStorageD sn st)

def snapTrip_countable : Pos.Countable SnapTrip :=
  countableOfLeftInverse
    (fun k => (k.sid.term', k.sid.index', k.cl.voters, k.cl.learners, k.cl.outgoing, k.cl.learnersNext, k.al, k.dat))
    (fun p =>
      { sid := { term' := p.fst, index' := p.snd.fst },
        cl :=
          { voters := p.snd.snd.fst, learners := p.snd.snd.snd.fst, outgoing := p.snd.snd.snd.snd.fst,
            learnersNext := p.snd.snd.snd.snd.snd.fst },
        al := p.snd.snd.snd.snd.snd.snd.fst, dat := p.snd.snd.snd.snd.snd.snd.snd })
    ⋯

theorem isStorageWith_pers (P : StorState → IProp GF) (CT : Int → IProp GF) (SC : SnapshotM → IProp
    GF) (st : Storage) : Persistent (isStorageWith P CT SC st)

def StorState.kOut (σ : StorState) : Nat :=
  match σ.pend.head? with
  | some e0 => uint.nat e0.Index'
  | none => uint.nat σ.prev.index' + 1 + σ.ents.length

def ksnCert (sn : StorNames) (k : SnapTrip) : IProp GF :=
  iprop(∃ P, savedPredOwn sn.gk DFrac.discard P ∗ □ P k)

theorem ksnCerts_mem (sn : StorNames) (K : List SnapTrip) (k : SnapTrip) (h : k ∈ K) : ⊢ ksnCerts sn
    K -∗ ksnCert sn k

theorem storPast_mono (st : Storage) (m m' : Int) (h : m' ≤ m) : storPast st m ⊢ storPast st m'

theorem isStorageV_pers (sn : StorNames) (st : Storage) : Persistent (isStorageV sn st)

theorem raftDL_pers (sn : StorNames) (i : Nat) (t : w64) : Persistent (raftDL sn i t)

def storPast (st : Storage) (m : Int) : IProp GF :=
  iprop(∃ n, ⌜m ≤ n⌝ ∗ storCut st n)

theorem isStorageP_pers (SV : SnapshotM → IProp GF) (Bnd DL : Nat → IProp GF) (st : Storage) :
    Persistent (isStorageP SV Bnd DL st)

theorem storCompacted_pers.{u_1} (st : Storage) (c : Nat) : Persistent (storCompacted st c)
